prompts.value: Operate a meticulous pose transfer. Reconstruct the target character from [IMG_1], preserving their complete identity, features, expression, and clothing. The character's entire physical posture, including skeletal alignment, joint angles, and limb positions, must be strictly mapped from the reference person in [IMG_2] (which may be a photo or a 3D previz). Integrate this newly posed character seamlessly back into the original composition, background, lighting scheme, and color grading of [IMG_1]. Ensure 100% structural fidelity of the scene and all elements except the character's pose. MANDATORY: No text on image. No captions, no labels, no watermarks, no overlays. Pure cinematic imagery only.
the object's 3D orientation, exact frame placement, scale relative to the frame, negative space, and shot scale
Infrared thermal imaging camera, heat signature palette
shot on DJI Inspire 3, Zenmuse X9-8K, 18mm aerial wide lens
